parsedVerdict.reasoning: The three services share one concern: benefit cards and the payments and recharges made with them. However, the card-usability invariant (the card must exist, must not be blocked and must not be expired) is not kept in one place. Four operations across all three files re-implement it inline with the same thrown error objects: paymentServices.insertPayment, paymentServices.insertOnlinePayment, rechargeService.recharge and cardServices.getCardStatement. activateCard, blockCard and unblockCard in cardServices.ts copy the exists and expiry checks again. The module already has a shared helper for parts of this rule (cardUtils.checkCardExpiration and checkPassword) but leaves the existence and blocked checks scattered. paymentServices also repeats the business-not-found check and the balance-sufficiency step in both payment functions. It then calls cardServices.getCardStatement, which fetches the card again and repeats the blocked check, so the payment flow checks the same card twice. The import of controller types is out of scope.

violations.message: insertPayment and insertOnlinePayment each re-implement the card-usability invariant (exists, not blocked, not expired) and the business-exists and balance checks inline instead of using one shared check.
recharge copies the same card exists, not-blocked and expiry checks, with the same error objects, instead of using a shared card-validation abstraction.
getCardStatement, activateCard, blockCard and unblockCard each repeat the find-card/notFound/blocked/expiry logic, which is duplicated across the module instead of living in one place.
